description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/clinical-trials/search (base $0.005; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?condition=asthma (or intervention=...; optional status=RECRUITING|NOT_YET_RECRUITING|ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING|COMPLETED|TERMINATED, phase=1-4, limit=1-20). Clinical trials search: up to 20 ClinicalTrials.gov studies by condition and/or intervention, optional status and phase. Returns NCT ID, title, status, phases, lead sponsor, start and last-update dates and link, with the registry's data-processed date. Not medical advice; not endorsed by NLM/NIH; listed studies are not all reviewed by the U.S. government. No results, bad input or source down: not charged. USDC on Base only.
